evidence_limitations: All 142 baseline archive entries were visually reviewed. Contact-sheet overviews retain aspect ratios; they are derived review aids, not source-resolution exports.
Every archive file decodes and matches its registry Git blob. Reused basenames do not identify the same historical image.
Time fields distinguish Git save and image registration. No capture time is independently established for historical images.
fullbody-refit/all-mesh-strain.json is one unsplit mesh; seams.passed true with pairs 0 is not evidence for four-mesh seam validation.
APK/browser evidence explicitly records Cloud Chromium and androidDeviceTested false.
Current docs/anim-report/apk-review PNGs match baseline entries 139 through 142, not older entries 134 through 138 that retain those source paths.
